issue.title: Show caption and attribution for Images & Maps [Viewing and listening to resources Audit]
issue.body:
Found during the viewing and listening to resources audit (#531, epic #526).

**Severity:** Medium  
**Launch blocker:** To be decided with product (image licenses may require attribution)  
**Confirmed on:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), local run of `main` @ `fb634e5`, `dev.api.fluent.bible` (scenarios D.10)

## Summary
Images & Maps thumbnails show a title only. #191 requires title/caption and attribution. fluent-api returns `id`, `title`, `localizedName`, `url`, `thumbnailUrl?`, `size?` (`src/types/api/translationResources.ts:31-38`), and `parseTranslationImageItem` keeps title and URL (`src/services/imagesMaps.ts:29-47`). The UI already renders caption and attribution when present (`src/app/tabs/resources/ImageThumbnail.tsx:92-95`). `thumbnailUrl` is also ignored, so thumbnails download the full image.

## Expected
Each thumbnail shows title/caption and attribution (#191).

## Actual
D.10: Mark 1 thumbnails show only a title ("Locations in the Book of Mark"); no caption or attribution. The fullscreen viewer shows the title next to Close.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Online, open a verse with images (e.g. one QA used for #191).
2. Resources → Images & Maps.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] fluent-api returns caption and attribution for image items. The fluent-api issue is opened at implementation time and linked here.
- [ ] Mobile maps them and shows them under each thumbnail.
- [ ] Thumbnails use `thumbnailUrl` when present; fullscreen uses `url`.
- [ ] Unit tests for the mapper.
- [ ] Android device QA.

## Related
- Spec: #191
- fluent-api #273 / PR #274
- Parent audit: #531 (epic #526)
- Related gap: #593 (also needs fluent-api translation-resources changes)
- Assessment: `docs/assessments/viewing-and-listening-to-resources/README.md` (PR #590)
